name: phone_mockup
description: A panel over the top half while the speaker moves to the bottom half: a phone showing the business's post (its logo and name, a picture made of an icon, a short headline and a button), and beside it a title, two or three chips popping in, and optionally a switch a cursor turns on, a success badge and hearts flying up from the post. For an app, an online service, ordering on the phone, an advert going live - anything that happens on a phone.

title.description: The title beside the phone, e.g. 'Targeting', 'Buyurtma'.

chips.description: Two or three short chips, in the order they are said, e.g. 'Toshkent', '18-35 yosh'.

headline.description: Optional: the words on the post's picture.

icon.description: Optional: the drawing on the post's picture.

toggle.description: Optional: what the switch turns on, e.g. 'Reklamani yoqish'.

badge.description: Optional: the success badge after the switch, e.g. 'Buyurtma qabul qilindi'.

beats.chips: Each chip pops in on the word that says it, in order.
beats.switch: The word on which the cursor turns the switch on.
